description:
About BritishVita:


BritishVita is a UK-based premium vitamins and supplements brand serving over 10,000 monthly website visitors. We offer high-quality nutritional supplements, multivitamins, minerals, and wellness products designed to support everyday health.


What makes us different:


We focus on premium formulations, transparent sourcing, competitive pricing, and fast UK delivery. Our brand is built for long-term customer retention and repeat purchases.


How affiliates earn:


Affiliates earn 10% commission on every approved sale with a 30-day tracking window. Manual approval ensures high-quality partnerships.


How to promote:


You can promote using affiliate links or discount codes. We are especially interested in UK-based health, wellness, fitness, and lifestyle publishers.


Additional information:


Commissions are reviewed in the first week of the following month to account for returns and refunds. Approved commissions are paid in the first week of the next month.
payout_period: Commissions are calculated during the first week of the following month after order validation (including returns and refunds). Payments are issued in the first week of the month after that.
term_and_condition:
Affiliates are not allowed to use spam, misleading advertising, trademark bidding, or unauthorized coupon distribution.

Commissions are paid only for valid and completed orders.

British Vita reserves the right to reject or remove affiliates who violate the program terms.

By joining the program, affiliates agree to promote British Vita in a professional and ethical manner.
